quotes.author: Mrs. Glesener
quotes.text: Stella and her team really took the time to create a unique experience for us, and I have recommended it to everyone I know. It is such a cool concept, that’s worth every penny. We will definitely have a day with them again soon!

quotes.author: Mrs. Rouleau
quotes.text: This was honestly the most fun experience I have had on Lady Bird Lake ever! The boat was set up with really great sandwiches, drinks and extra fun details like personalized pictures, games, a polaroid camera and more.

quotes.author: Amber
quotes.text: My husband got back from deployment and our first stop was an intimate picnic specially crafted to fit our families style. Afterwards he told me, “that’s exactly what I needed to just decompress and enjoy my family.

quotes.author: Sarah
quotes.text: Love and Boat was such a fun and unique experience! The hosts were friendly and decorated the boat perfectly for our event. You can bring your own food/drink which was super cool. We had a fantastic time!

quotes.author: Renee
quotes.text: Love and Boat was not only picture perfect but a really, really fun experience for me and my friends. I would highly recommend them if you want a unique and memorable experience! Five Stars!!!
